experience.description: Help clients by providing solutions that foster growth and efficiency through Data Engineering and Architecture services.
Worked on building an ingestion platform that pulls in data from Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and processes them into a common data model for further processing and analysis.

Started as Data Services Manager leading Data Engineering and Data Science team, transitioned to Principal Machine Learning Engineer to focus on scaling data products and supporting machine learning model development and deployment.
Worked on Data Operations team enhancing intake and processing of client data, transferred to Data Science team to streamline development, deployment, and management of models.
Supported analytic groups through developing data pipelines, warehousing data, developing and maintaining reporting and dashboard solutions.
Worked in engineering department supporting development, testing, and troubleshooting field issues for software products.
Worked as analyst in support of PATRIOT System Effectiveness Model (PSEM), a simulation model of the PATRIOT missile defense system.

Optimized ETL processes for US real estate data, handling over 100 million records per batch. Focused on cost-efficiency and delivery speed. Implemented complex business logic to ensure the most reliable and up-to-date data for customers and data consumers.

Led the design and implementation of a robust data lake architecture for GMG, integrating data from diverse sources such as SAP, SFTP, and REST APIs. Created a centralized, real-time data platform leveraging AWS Glue and Databricks. Spearheaded development of an internal ETL pipeline to consolidate data from various sources like GitHub and ClickUp.

Led the ETL setup for unstructured retail business data across all Loyalytics clients, building a robust data lake architecture using Delta Live Tables and Apache Kafka streaming services. Developed and self-managed a scalable, reusable data lifecycle framework that ingests various file types and integrates with Unity Catalog and Delta Live Tables.

Led ETL setup for diverse data sources like MySQL, Oracle DB, SQL Server, and Oracle Fusion. Migrated from Oracle Data Integrator to Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory. Oversaw setup of ETL pipelines for SQL Server and Microsoft SharePoint data. Established robust data lake architecture using Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks.

Various full stack and backend development projects focused on creating robust, user-friendly web applications. Contributed to frontend and backend development for mental healthcare platform. Developed APIs and features for personalized sneaker styling service and Ed-Tech business.
